reviews.title: You should get this game if you want to be entertained, then bored after a while.
reviews.text: So, hi, l’m Aubrey, and did you know that butterflies taste with their feet? Anyway, this game only lets you have 2 characters, and only Adventure Bay, and nowhere else. I REALLY wanted to be a different character in Atlantis and be a mermaid, and other places. Also, the quests are too easy. They just show you where the item is and you have to follow a trail to get there, which takes about 6 seconds. Thanks for reading this! This game will entertain your child for about a day or so, and then you have to unlock everything, or you will be bored for the rest of the whole gameplay. Sorry l’m so annoying, but my Mom said try not to, so l guess l’ll end the report. Bye, have a lovely day, and remember, look before you leap! 💎🍕🍿🌸🌪️😄🙁😕🙁😕🙁😕😉

reviews.title: Overpriced and Glitchy
reviews.text: Honestly, I just got this for my daughter and paid $15 for it and I’m already about to cancel my subscription after less than a day. We are repeatedly trying to access parts of the world that we paid for just to be left on a never-ending loading screen. What kind of game cost this much but the developers can’t even make sure it works properly?

reviews.title: Paywall Issues
reviews.text:
Can’t necessary blame the makers of this game as all the kids games follow the same predatory subscription model of $50+ year to access the full version of the app. 

It’s a little disturbing as it seems only kids games have this type of paywall. 🤔 All other apps have a one-time purchase option at a reasonable price.

Due to these practices, I will not be showing this game to my children.
